entities.summary: Charles Morrell Jordan was an American automotive designer, widely known for his role as vice president of design for General Motors from 1986 to 1992 — and his work on prominent GM models, including the 1959-1960 Cadillac Eldorado and the 1992 Cadillac Seville STS.
